codes.title: Idempotency key reused
codes.description: The same Idempotency-Key was sent with a different request body.

codes.title: Internal error
codes.description: A bug on our side, including the output of panic recovery.

codes.title: Invalid credential
codes.description: A credential was sent but it is invalid, expired, or revoked.

codes.title: Invalid cursor
codes.description: The cursor cannot be parsed or is no longer valid.

codes.title: Invalid parameter
codes.description: A parameter is syntactically wrong: a boolean that is not true/false, an integer that is not an integer, a date that is not YYYY-MM-DD.

codes.title: Limit too large
codes.description: limit is greater than 100. The value is not clamped.

codes.title: Malformed body
codes.description: Request body is not valid JSON, or is not a valid instance of the declared media type.

codes.title: Method not allowed
codes.description: The path exists but this method does not.

codes.title: Missing credential
codes.description: The request has no Authorization header.

codes.title: Not found
codes.description: Nothing visible exists at this URL.

codes.title: Rate limited
codes.description: A rate limit was exceeded. Retry-After, in seconds, is present only when the limiter says when to retry.

codes.title: Scope required
codes.description: The credential is valid but lacks the scope this operation needs.

codes.title: Service unavailable
codes.description: A dependency is unavailable. The request may be retried.

codes.title: Unknown enum value
codes.description: A closed vocabulary received an unknown token at parse time.

codes.title: Unknown sort
codes.description: sort= received a key this collection has not declared.

codes.title: Unsupported media type
codes.description: The request body media type is not supported.

codes.title: Validation failed
codes.description: The request is syntactically valid but semantically not. errors[] is present and non-empty.

codes.title: Account banned
codes.description: The signed-in user's account is banned.

codes.title: Content rejected
codes.description: The trust-and-safety check refused the submitted text. Nothing was written.

codes.title: Draft limit reached
codes.description: The caller already holds the maximum number of drafts. A draft is never overwritten, so the only way to make room is to delete one. limit is that number.

codes.title: Idempotency request in progress
codes.description: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry after it completes.

codes.title: Moemoepoint insufficient
codes.description: The caller's moemoepoint balance, as this forum last cached it, is below what the operation costs. required is that cost.

codes.title: Poll closed
codes.description: The poll no longer accepts votes: it is past closes_at. Nothing about the request is wrong.

codes.title: Quiz answer required
codes.description: The quiz hides its game or carries spoilers, so its comment wall is open only to its author and to users who have answered it.

codes.title: Self like forbidden
codes.description: Users cannot like their own topics, replies or comments.

codes.title: Self upvote forbidden
codes.description: Users cannot upvote their own topics.

codes.title: Topic daily limit reached
codes.description: The caller has created as many topics in the last 24 hours as their moemoepoint balance allows. limit is that number.

codes.title: Vote already cast
codes.description: The caller has already voted and this poll does not allow changing a vote.

codes.title: Invalid state transition
codes.description: The current state does not allow this transition. detail names the current state.

codes.title: Permission required
codes.description: The token lacks the permission this decision needs.

reasons.title: Duplicate item
reasons.description: An array that must be unique contains a duplicate.

reasons.title: Immutable
reasons.description: This field cannot be changed in the current state.

reasons.title: Inconsistent with
reasons.description: The value contradicts another field. detail names that field's pointer.

reasons.title: Invalid format
reasons.description: The value does not match the expected format (date, URI, hash, id string).

reasons.title: Not allowed value
reasons.description: The value is in the vocabulary but is not accepted in this context.

reasons.title: Not permitted
reasons.description: The caller is not allowed to act on this position. Unlike IMMUTABLE this is about the actor, not the field's state.

reasons.title: Out of range
reasons.description: A numeric value is out of range, including a date outside the allowed interval.

reasons.title: Required
reasons.description: A required field is missing or null.

reasons.title: Too few items
reasons.description: The array has fewer items than its minimum.

reasons.title: Too long
reasons.description: A string is longer than its maxLength.

reasons.title: Too many items
reasons.description: An array exceeds its item limit.

reasons.title: Too short
reasons.description: A string is shorter than its minLength.

reasons.title: Unknown reference
reasons.description: The value refers to an entity that is not visible. Absence, merge, and visibility filtering are not distinguished.

reasons.title: Unknown value
reasons.description: The value is not in this field's closed vocabulary.
